author: CC
at_sea: Display standardization completed. Three reporting surfaces — operator_inbox, harbor_master show map, codemother show dashboard — now share priority ordering (unexpected → troubles → email → adjudication → design → PROVEME → BUILDME → WATCHME → done), consistent ticket atom format (date/state/hex/title), and a single TERMINAL_STATES constant in transitions.py. harbor_master show map open correctly filters terminal-state boats. codemother show dashboard is a new command showing the full coding system. All 128 tests pass (69 harbor_master + 18 operator_inbox + 41 codemother). Both repos committed and pushed (cairn cb33ce6, CairnCommons b63f27d). CC++ received on the delivered commands.
